get.description: The full color guide as a JSON file (same layout as Winterchilla's public `mlpvc-colorguide.json`, which tools such as the swatch import script for Adobe Illustrator read; colors of private appearances are left out). Public, kept for an hour

Download the appearance's colors as a palette file: `json` is a nested swatch map (appearance, color group, color label to hex; the Illustrator swatch import format) and `gpl` is a GIMP/Inkscape palette. Both are served as attachments. Front ends may also build them from `GET /appearances/{id}/color-groups`.

200.description: The palette file, as an attachment named after the appearance

get.description: A rendered image of the appearance. Combinations: `palette` as `png` (the colors listed next to the sprite), `sprite` as `png` (the uploaded sprite) or `svg` (traced from it), `preview` as `svg` (the four-color preview) and `facing` as `svg` (the body-orientation graphic, colored with the appearance's colors; pick the side with `facing`). Everything else is a 422, a missing sprite a 404. The server may answer with a redirect to a cache-busted URL of the same image.

404.description: Appearance not found, or it has no sprite

major.description: Record as a major change (official guide only)

MajorChangeList.description: An array of major change items under the changes key

GuideMajorChangesPageSize.description: The number of results to return per page

IsoStandardDate.description: An ISO 8601 standard compliant date as a string

PageNumber.description: A query parameter used for specifying which page is currently being displayed

EventEntry.description: A submission made to a community event

link.description: URL of the submitted deviation or Sta.sh submission

prevSrc.description: URL of the custom preview image, if one was provided

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries a single user may submit

entryRole.description: Minimum role (or special role identifier) required to submit entries

voteRole.description: Minimum role (or special role identifier) required to vote

resultFavMe.description: fav.me ID of the winning entry's deviation, once finalized

descriptionHtml.description: The description rendered to (already sanitized) HTML

Notice.description: A site-wide notice shown until it is hidden

messageHtml.description: Printable ASCII only; unsafe HTML is stripped

showId.description: ID of the show entry this post belongs to

imageUrl.description: URL of the image or deviation to post (see POST /posts/check-image for what is accepted)

label.description: What the post is about; required for requests, optional for reservations

type.description: What a request asks for; required for requests, ignored for reservations

postAs.description: Developer-only: DeviantArt username to post as

allowNonmember.description: Developer-only: post a reservation as a user who is not a club member

ShowList.description: An array of public show entries under the show key

ShowListPageSize.description: The number of results to return per page

Show.description: Represents a show entry (episode or movie/special)

parts.description: Number of parts the episode is split into (1 or 2)

postedBy.description: ID of the user who created this show entry

type.description: Required when creating. Cannot be changed to episode via update

twoparter.description: Marks the episode as a two-parter

addTo.description: Only when creating: appearance to add the new tag to

PreferenceValue.description: The current (or newly set) value of a user preference

value.description: The preference value. Type depends on the specified preference key.

BarePublicUser.description: Represents the absolute minimum info necessary to get a user profile URL

allOf.description: Represents a publicly accessible representation of a user

CurrentUser.description: The signed in user as returned by `GET /users/me`, never includes the e-mail address

name.description: Name of the token, either generated (from OS and browser version) or user-supplied if renamed

lastUsedAt.description: Null for a token that was never used

BrowserSession.description: A browser session of the current user (cookie authentication)

id.description: Opaque identifier to pass to DELETE /users/sessions/{id}. Not the session id itself

device.description: Browser and operating system the session was started from

userAgent.description: The raw User-Agent header the session was started with

ip.description: IP address the session was last used from

current.description: Whether this is the session that made the request

PostItem.description: A request or reservation on a show's page, as data

type.description: What the request asks for; requests only

finishedAt.description: Set once the post has a deviation

approved.description: Whether the finished post has been accepted to the club gallery

approvedAt.description: When the post was approved, null when it is not or the date was not kept

approvedBy.description: Who approved the post, only given to staff

broken.description: Whether the image was deemed unavailable; only staff see broken posts

overdue.description: Reserved and unfinished for over 3 weeks, so others may reserve it

canEdit.description: Whether the current user may edit the post

PostReserver.description: The user who reserved a post, with what is needed to show them next to it

vectorApp.description: The vector program the user chose to show publicly

AccountRole.description: The role of a user account (`guest` only exists as a permission level for signed-out visitors). A developer is shown under the label of the `dev_role_label` setting on public payloads.

Appearance.description: Represents an entry in the color guide

AppearanceList.description: A page of appearances under the appearances key

appearances.description: Schemas that describe responses of the API. Their shapes match what the API returns and were checked with scripts/validate-responses.py.

AvatarProvider.description: Where a user's avatar comes from. Winterchilla only knows DeviantArt avatars; other implementations may also use Discord or Gravatar.

Color.description: A color entry. Colors may link to other colors, in which case `linkedTo` will be set to the link target, but `hex` will always point to the value that should be displayed.

hex.description: The color value in uppercase hexadecimal form, including a # prefix

linkedTo.description: This field used to indicate if this color was linked to another color, however, this feature was removed and this field now only ever returns null

viewUrl.description: The URL used for displaying the cutie mark SVG file.

facing.description: The direction the character is facing when this cutie mark should be used. `null` means the image is symmetrical.

favMe.description: Optional ID of a deviation on DeviantArt that is the original source of this cutie mark vector.

label.description: Optional label in case the cutie mark warrants additional information.

DetailedAppearance.description: An appearance object containing the full range of information available

relatedAppearances.description: Appearances this one is linked to, e.g. other versions of the same character

relatedShows.description: Shows this appearance is linked to

canEdit.description: Whether the current user may edit this appearance (its owner, or staff)

message.description: An error message describing what caused the request to fail

GitInfo.description: Contains information about the server's current revision

initiator.description: Null when the web server itself made the change

hasDetails.description: Whether GET /admin/logs/{id} has anything to show

user.description: Who made the change; only sent to staff

Order.description: Used for displaying items in a specific order. The API guarantees that array return values are sorted in ascending order based on this property.

Post.description: Represents an art post (request or reservation)

type.description: Request type, only present for requests

reservedAt.description: Date the request was reserved, or an empty string if not set. Only present for developers viewing a reserved request

finishedAt.description: Date the post was finished, or an empty string if not set. Only present for developers when the post is reserved and finished

PreviewAppearance.description: The barest of properties for an appearance, enough to show a small colored preview

nutshellNames.description: Names the appearance can be shown as in the 2020 nutshell names mode. When the visitor's cg_nutshell preference is on, show one of them (picked at random) instead of the label, or the lowercased label when the list is empty. Always empty for personal guide appearances, which are never renamed

ownerId.description: ID of the user whose personal guide the appearance belongs to; null for the official guides

guide.description: The guide the appearance belongs to; null for personal guide appearances

previewData.description: Up to four hex colors (#rrggbb) that represent the appearance

PreviewsIndicator.description: Optional parameter that indicates whether you would like to get preview image data with the request. Typically unneccessary unless you want to display a temporary image while the larger image loads.

label.description: The display name of the appearance

notes.description: Raw (markdown) source of the appearance's notes

private.description: Whether this appearance is only visible to its owner and staff

PrivateColor.description: Represents a single color within a color group

PrivateColorGroup.description: Represents a color group belonging to an appearance

colors.description: Only present in the GET response

RegexPattern.description: A regular expression in the form JavaScript's RegExp constructor takes it

sessionUpdating.description: If this value is true the DeviantArt access token expired and the backend is updating it in the background. Future requests should be made to the appropriate endpoint periodically (TODO) to check whether the session update was successful and the user should be logged out if it wasn't.

minRole.description: The lowest role that can see this link

SlimAppearance.description: A less heavy version of the regular Appearance schema

guide.description: The official guide the appearance belongs to; null for personal guide appearances (see ownerId)

ownerId.description: ID of the user whose personal guide the appearance belongs to; null for the official guides

previewData.description: Up to four hex colors (#rrggbb) that represent the appearance, for small previews and cards

notes.example: Far legs use darker colors. Based on S2E21.

sprite.description: The sprite that belongs to this appearance, or null if there is none

hasCutieMarks.description: Indicates whether there are any cutie marks tied to this appearance

lastMajorChange.description: When the appearance's last major change was recorded; not part of Winterchilla's contract, which renders it as HTML in the guide list. Not set on the compact items of the full list

SlimAppearanceList.description: All appearances of a guide in the requested order, under the appearances key, plus how to group them

groups.description: Sections of the list: by tag group for `relevance` (the staff-managed order within), by first letter for `label`, none for `added`

type.description: Category this tag belongs to, or null if uncategorized

Sprite.description: Data related to an appearance's sprite file. The image itself is `GET /appearances/{id}/sprite?size=300|600&hash={hash}` (the hash is only there for cache busting); `preview`, when sent, is a tiny data URI with the same proportions for laying the page out before the image loads.

preview.description: Data URI for a small preview image with matching proportions to the actual image, suitable for displaying as a preview while the full image loads. May not be sent based on the request parameters.

title.description: Optional human-friendly title for the tag

type.description: The tag's type/category, null for a plain tag without one

uses.description: Number of appearances this tag is applied to

synonymOf.description: ID of the tag this one is a synonym of, if any

UsefulLinkInput.description: Used to create or update a useful link. 'title' is optional and defaults to an empty string if omitted

UserPrefs.description: The effective preference values (every key is optional when `keys[]` limits the result). The flags are booleans; defaults are in brackets in the descriptions below.

cg_itemsperpage.description: Appearances per page in the color guide [7]

p_vectorapp.description: The vector app shown next to the user's name, empty for none

pcg_slots.description: Personal guide slots granted by staff [null]

UserProfile.description: Everything the profile page shows about a user, with what the current visitor may do with it

deviantArtUrl.description: The user's DeviantArt profile (not in Winterchilla's contract, which renders the profile as HTML)

vectorApp.description: The vector program the user chose to show publicly (preference p_vectorapp)

discordName.description: Name of the user on the club's Discord server

discord.description: The linked Discord account, only for the user themselves and staff; null when there is none

linked.description: false for accounts that staff bound manually, which no longer count

account.description: Sign in details for the Security section of the account page, only for the user themselves and staff

personalGuideProgress.description: Only for the user themselves and staff: whole slots the user has and how many more approved requests give another one

pendingReservations.description: Reservations that are not finished yet; only for the user themselves and for staff visiting a member

sameUser.description: Whether the visitor is looking at their own profile

canEdit.description: Whether the visitor may change this user's role

devOnDev.description: Whether a developer is looking at a developer (may change the displayed role label)

editableRoles.description: Roles the visitor may assign, key to label

previousUsernames.description: Only sent to the user themselves and to staff

personalGuides.description: Null when the user keeps their personal guide section private from the visitor

awaitingApproval.description: Finished posts waiting for approval; null when the user is not a member

UserRole.description: List of roles a user can have

errors.description: A map containing error messages for each field that did not pass validation

ValueOfUser.description: A user's data under the user key

AppearancePreviewData.format: Array of HEX color values, minimum 1, maximum 4, or null for no preview

AutocompleteAppearance.description: The barest of properties for an appearance intended for use in autocompletion results

sprite.description: The sprite that belongs to this appearance, or null if there is none

CommonAppearance.description: Common properties of the two main Appearance schemas

hasCutieMarks.description: Indicates whether there are any cutie marks tied to this appearance

SlimAppearanceOnly.description: Represents properties that belong to the slim appearance object only

AppearanceOnly.description: Represents properties that belong to the full appearance object only

notes.example: Far legs use darker colors. Based on S2E21.

FavMe.description: DeviantArt's shorthand URL format, which typically takes the form of `http://fav.me/d######`, where `#` is the base-36 encoded version of the deviation's numerical ID, found at the end of the deviation URL. This value includes the leading `d`.

CutieMarkRotation.description: The number of degrees to rotate the cutie mark image on the UI to better reflect its potion in the preview. Purely for cosmetic use.

label.description: The name of the color group

colors.description: The list of colors inside this group

CommitData.description: An object containing information related to the verion of this appilcation that's currently running on the server

commitId.description: Abbreviated commit ID of the backend application, indicating the version currently deployed on the server (at least 7 characters long)

commitTime.description: Date at which the commit currently deployed on the server was authored

BearerAuth.description: Can be used to authenticate using a token sent via HTTP headers

CookieAuth.description: Used for session-based authentication, the cookie is set by the backend on qualifying requests (i.e. browser requests originating from our domain)
CookieAuth.name: mlp_vector_club_session
